description: Isolated power panel of the control room: an isolation transformer feeding the IT-earthed circuits, with an insulation monitor and CT and PE supervision. The asset source has its circuits and its readings but not the panel; the graphene supplement adds it between the L1 DB way and the circuits.

pe_disconnected.description: The panel's protective earth connection is lost.

ct_open.description: The load-current CT is disconnected (open circuit).

cooling_loss.description: The transformer's ventilation fails: it runs hotter at the same load.

rise_factor.description: Multiplier on the transformer's temperature rise.

name: Isolated power panel

insulation_healthy.description: Insulation resistance of the healthy isolated system in dry air.

power_in.description: Feed from the L1 DB way.
